THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE          29

[Photograph: Reproduction of a page from a catalog. Text reads:

SAVOY COLLEGE.

HISTORY.

THIS Institution was established in 1876, and continued to increase until its founders were induced to have it chartered, under the laws of the State of Texas, authorizing the chartering of institutions of learning.

CALENDAR FOR 1887-8.

First term begins September 1, 1887. First term ends December 23, 1887. In session sixteen weeks.

Second term begins January 2, 1888. Second term ends June 1, 1888. In session twenty-two weeks.
